name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
target_group: Girl child under 10 years of age
benefit: Government-backed, tax-free long-term savings account with high interest (Min Rs 250/yr, Max Rs 1.5 lakh/yr; matures at 21 years or marriage after 18)
documents: Parent/Guardian's Aadhaar Card and PAN Card
office_to_visit: Nearest Post Office or authorized public/private sector bank

what_to_say_templates.en: I want to open a Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) account for my daughter.
what_to_say_templates.bn: আমি আমার মেয়ের জন্য সুকন্যা সমৃদ্ধি যোজনা (SSY) অ্যাকাউন্ট খুলতে চাই।
what_to_say_templates.hi: मैं अपनी बेटी के लिए सुकन्या समृद्धि योजना (SSY) खाता खोलना चाहता/चाहती हूँ।

name: Anganwadi Services (ICDS) — Nutrition, Immunisation & Pre-School
target_group: Children aged 0–6 years, pregnant women, and lactating mothers
benefit: Ask at the office for local schedule and rations (Supplementary nutrition, hot cooked meals / take-home rations, growth monitoring, free immunisation, health check-ups, and pre-school education)
documents: Parent's Aadhaar Card / Ration Card / Local ID Proof
office_to_visit: Nearest Anganwadi Centre (AWC) or local ASHA worker

what_to_say_templates.en: I want to inquire about Anganwadi supplementary nutrition and maternal child healthcare services.
what_to_say_templates.bn: আমি অঙ্গনওয়াড়ি পুষ্টি ও মাতৃদুগ্ধ পানকারী/শিশু স্বাস্থ্যসেবা সম্পর্কে জানতে চাই।
what_to_say_templates.hi: मैं आंगनवाड़ी पूरक पोषण और मातृ-शिशु स्वास्थ्य सेवाओं के बारे में जानकारी लेने आया/आई हूँ।

name: Kanyashree Prakalpa (K1 & K2)
benefit: K1 (Age 13–18): Annual scholarship of Rs 750/year. K2 (Age 18–19): One-time grant of Rs 25,000
documents: Birth Certificate (or Head Teacher's age certificate)
Family Income Statement (or disability / death certificate)
Bank Passbook in girl's own name (with IFSC & account number)
office_to_visit: Head of School/College/Institution (online uploaded to WB Kanyashree portal)

what_to_say_templates.en: I am an unmarried female student aged {age} in West Bengal applying for Kanyashree Prakalpa.
what_to_say_templates.bn: আমি পশ্চিমবঙ্গের {age} বছর বয়সী অবিবাহিত ছাত্রী, কন্যাশ্রী প্রকল্পের জন্য আবেদন করতে চাই।
what_to_say_templates.hi: मैं पश्चिम बंगाल की {age} साल की अविवाहित छात्रा हूँ, कन्याश्री प्रकल्प के लिए आवेदन करना चाहती हूँ।

name: Rupashree Prakalpa
target_group: Unmarried adult women aged 18+ proposing first marriage
benefit: One-time financial grant of Rs 25,000 transferred to bride's bank account prior to marriage
documents: Age Proof (Birth Certificate, Voter ID, PAN, or Madhyamik Admit Card)
Proof of Residence (Self-declaration / local authority verification)
Proof of proposed marriage (wedding invitation card / registration notice)
Groom's age proof and passport-size photograph
Applicant's Voter ID, Aadhaar Card, and Income Declaration
office_to_visit: Block Development Office (BDO), SDO, or Municipal Corporation / Municipality office (30–60 days before marriage)

what_to_say_templates.en: I am a resident of West Bengal aged {age} proposing my marriage and applying for Rupashree Prakalpa grant.
what_to_say_templates.bn: আমি পশ্চিমবঙ্গের বাসিন্দা, আমার বয়স {age} বছর। আমার বিয়ের জন্য রূপশ্রী প্রকল্পের অনুদানের আবেদন করতে চাই।
what_to_say_templates.hi: मैं पश्चिम बंगाल की निवासी हूँ, मेरी उम्र {age} साल है। मैं अपने विवाह हेतु रूपश्री प्रकल्प अनुदान के लिए आवेदन करना चाहती हूँ।

name: PG Indira Gandhi Scholarship for Single Girl Child
target_group: Single girl child pursuing Postgraduate (PG) higher education
benefit: Fellowship of Rs 36,200 per annum for 2 years (full duration of PG course)
documents: Proof of admission to 1st year PG course
Single Girl Child Affidavit (on stamp paper attested by SDM / First Class Magistrate)
Copy of Aadhaar Card / ID Proof

what_to_say_templates.en: I am a single girl child enrolled in a PG course applying for the PG Indira Gandhi Scholarship.
what_to_say_templates.bn: আমি পরিবারের একমাত্র কন্যা সন্তান এবং স্নাতকোত্তর কোর্সে পাঠরত, পিজি ইন্দিরা গান্ধী বৃত্তির জন্য আবেদন করতে চাই।
what_to_say_templates.hi: मैं परिवार की इकलौती बेटी हूँ और पीजी कोर्स में पढ़ रही हूँ, पीजी इंदिरा गांधी स्कॉलरशिप के लिए आवेदन करना चाहती हूँ।

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY 2.0)
target_group: Pregnant women and lactating mothers aged 19+
benefit: 1st living child: Rs 5,000 paid in 2 instalments via DBT; 2nd living child (if a girl): Rs 6,000 paid in a single instalment
documents: Aadhaar-seeded Bank or Post Office Passbook
Mother and Child Protection (MCP) / RCHI Card (showing LMP & ANC dates)
office_to_visit: Nearest Anganwadi Centre (AWC), ASHA/ANM worker, or online PMMVY Citizen Portal

what_to_say_templates.en: I am a pregnant/lactating mother aged {age} and want to apply for maternity support under PMMVY.
what_to_say_templates.bn: আমি {age} বছর বয়সী গর্ভবতী/প্রসূতি মা, পিএমএমভিওয়াই (PMMVY) মাতৃত্ব সুবিধার জন্য আবেদন করতে চাই।
what_to_say_templates.hi: मैं {age} साल की गर्भवती/धात्री महिला हूँ, मातृ वंदना योजना (PMMVY) के तहत सहायता राशि के लिए आवेदन करना चाहती हूँ।

name: Annapurna Yojana (West Bengal)
scope: West Bengal State (Replaces Lakshmir Bhandar from 1 June 2026)
target_group: Adult women aged 25–60 years residing in West Bengal
benefit: Rs 3,000 per month transferred via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly to an Aadhaar-linked bank account
documents: Aadhaar Card (carry copy; do not share full number in chat)
Aadhaar-linked Bank Passbook (sole account in applicant's name)
office_to_visit: Block Development Office (BDO), Duare Sarkar camp, or local Municipal / Gram Panchayat office

what_to_say_templates.en: I am a resident of West Bengal aged {age} and would like to check my eligibility and apply for Annapurna Yojana.
what_to_say_templates.bn: আমি পশ্চিমবঙ্গের বাসিন্দা, আমার বয়স {age} বছর। আমি অন্নপূর্ণা যোজনার জন্য আবেদন করতে ও যোগ্যতা যাচাই করতে চাই।
what_to_say_templates.hi: मैं पश्चिम बंगाल की निवासी हूँ, मेरी उम्र {age} साल है। मैं अन्नपूर्णा योजना के लिए आवेदन और पात्रता की जांच कराना चाहती हूँ।

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
benefit: Central share of Rs 300 per month (age 40–79) and Rs 500 per month (age 80+), plus applicable state top-up
documents: Age Proof (Birth Certificate, School Certificate, Ration Card, or Voter ID)
office_to_visit: Block Development Office (BDO), Gram Panchayat, Municipality Social Welfare counter, or via UMANG portal

what_to_say_templates.en: I am a widow aged {age} from a BPL household and want to apply for the Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS).
what_to_say_templates.bn: আমি {age} বছর বয়সী বিধবা এবং বিপিএল পরিবারের সদস্য। আমি বিধবা পেনশন (IGNWPS) এর জন্য আবেদন করতে চাই।
what_to_say_templates.hi: मैं {age} साल की विधवा हूँ और बीपीएल परिवार से हूँ। मैं विधवा पेंशन (IGNWPS) के लिए आवेदन करना चाहती हूँ।

name: West Bengal Widow Pension Scheme
target_group: Destitute widows residing in West Bengal
benefit: Rs 1,000 per month pension via DBT
documents: Voter ID Card and Aadhaar Card
Bank Passbook details and Passport-size photograph
office_to_visit: BDO office, Duare Sarkar camp, or Municipal office

what_to_say_templates.en: I am a destitute widow residing in West Bengal and want to apply for the State Widow Pension Scheme.
what_to_say_templates.bn: আমি পশ্চিমবঙ্গের বিধবা বাসিন্দা, আমি রাজ্য বিধবা পেনশনের জন্য আবেদন করতে চাই।
what_to_say_templates.hi: मैं पश्चिम बंगाल की निवासी विधवा हूँ, मैं राज्य विधवा पेंशन योजना के लिए आवेदन करना चाहती हूँ।

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
target_group: Senior citizens aged 60+ from BPL households
benefit: Central monthly pension for BPL senior citizens (Rs 200/month for 60–79 yrs; Rs 500/month for 80+ yrs) plus applicable state top-up
documents: Age Proof (Voter ID, Birth Certificate, or Medical Board age certificate)
office_to_visit: Block Development Office (BDO), Gram Panchayat, Municipality Social Welfare counter, or via UMANG portal

what_to_say_templates.en: I am {age} years old from a BPL household and want to apply for the Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS).
what_to_say_templates.bn: আমার বয়স {age} বছর এবং আমি বিপিএল পরিবারের সদস্য। আমি বার্ধক্য পেনশন (IGNOAPS) এর জন্য আবেদন করতে চাই।
what_to_say_templates.hi: मेरी उम्र {age} साल है और मैं बीपीएल परिवार से हूँ। मैं वृद्धावस्था पेंशन (IGNOAPS) के लिए आवेदन करना चाहती हूँ।

name: West Bengal Old Age Pension Scheme
target_group: Elderly residents of West Bengal aged 60+
benefit: Rs 1,000 per month via DBT (combined central share + state top-up where applicable)
documents: Age Proof (Birth Certificate / Voter ID / Aadhaar Card)
office_to_visit: BDO office, Duare Sarkar camp, or Municipal office

what_to_say_templates.en: I am a senior citizen aged {age} residing in West Bengal applying for the West Bengal Old Age Pension.
what_to_say_templates.bn: আমি পশ্চিমবঙ্গের {age} বছর বয়সী প্রবীণ নাগরিক, রাজ্য বার্ধক্য পেনশনের জন্য আবেদন করতে চাই।
what_to_say_templates.hi: मैं पश्चिम बंगाल का/की {age} साल का वरिष्ठ नागरिक हूँ, राज्य वृद्धावस्था पेंशन के लिए आवेदन करना चाहता/चाहती हूँ।
